13. I am an Authorised Signatory (獲授權簽署證書人士) for SDN applications.

Mr Yim Choi Wah Alex (嚴財華)  
14. He is also one of the five directors and holds approximately 30% of the shares.

15. He is responsible for fire service electrical installations.

16. He is a Qualified Person (合資格人士) for SDN applications.

Ms Chung Man Wai (鍾文慰)  
17. She is an accounting clerk. She assisted me with paperwork and administrative matters.

(D) My responsibility: Application for Shut Down Notices

18. One of my key responsibilities is to apply for SDNs.

19. I only do so in two situations. First, after I or my staff have inspected the site, and secondly, when I am applying as a RFSIC for another company that is also a RFSIC.

SDN Application after site inspection  
20. When applying for SDN, my standard steps are:

(a) I or my staff would attend the site to inspect the works required;  
(b) This allows me to make the relevant plan;  
(c) I would then issue a quotation; and  
(d) If engaged, I would apply for the SDN where shutdown of Fire service installation/equipment is required or necessary.

Applying SDN for Other RFSICs  
21. China Status also assists other RFSICs in applying for SDNs.
